##### Project general facts

Uniestate Millennium Tower stands as a testament to architectural excellence and luxury living. This completed thirteen-floor project features a striking design and offers a collection of meticulously crafted apartments of varying sizes, each equipped with high-quality and luxurious features that ensure a premium living experience. The carefully designed floor plans reflect the exquisite architecture of the building, maximizing space and functionality while offering breathtaking views from every apartment.

At the pinnacle of the building, residents can indulge in exceptional leisure and wellness facilities, including pools and a gym, offering the perfect retreat to unwind and rejuvenate. The thoughtful design and premium amenities ensure that every aspect of daily living is elevated, creating a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.

Every residence at Uniestate Millennium Tower features full modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. The interiors are crafted with meticulous attention to detail, offering spaces that are both elegant and functional. The premium features and luxurious finishes throughout each apartment reflect a commitment to excellence, creating homes that are truly exceptional.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Silicon Oasis, a cutting-edge technology park and residential community strategically situated on Emirates Road, this exceptional location offers easy access to Dubai's major highways and landmarks. Spanning a significant area, the community is a hub for technology and innovation, home to numerous multinational technology companies, startups, and research institutions.

The location is distinguished by its state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of the tech industry, including advanced telecommunications, data centers, and modern office spaces. Residents enjoy a plethora of amenities, such as schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, parks, and recreational areas, creating a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern luxury, innovation, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Silicon Oasis delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of technological prominence, community amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
